items.title: Watch face complications
items.body: Add MonkeyWorkout to any watch face, analog ones too: next workout, weekly goal, streak, week strip, readiness, top lift, last workout. Long-press the face, Edit, then pick MonkeyWorkout.

items.title: Your goal shapes your week
items.body: Switching goal now changes this week's days, the mix of strength, power, mobility and cardio, and the exercises. Workouts you've done stay.

items.title: Bolder switchers
items.body: Explore's Muscles, Categories and Workouts switcher is now colourful tiles with counts. Same look in Community and the workout builder.
